record.question: Which among the following is the oldest Veda?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: The Rig Veda is the oldest of the four Vedas. It is a collection of hymns (suktas) transmitted orally in Sanskrit; “oldest” here compares the Vedic texts, not all surviving written records.
